stories.title: Why Central Luzon needs more than piecemeal flood projects
stories.summary:
Why Central Luzon needs more than piecemeal flood projects. Flooding across Central Luzon during the 2026 Habagat season exposed the limits of fragmented, short-term responses to one of the Philippines’ most persistent hazards.

Typhoon-enhanced monsoon rains, dam releases, high tides and reclamation projects combined to inundate parts of Bulacan, Pampanga and Tarlac.

Floodwaters reached 4 to 6 feet in many barangays, displacing thousands, submerging.

stories.title: Most cybercrimes still tied to SIM cards despite law – PNP
stories.summary:
Most cybercrimes still tied to SIM cards despite law – PNP. MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police-Anti-Cybercrime Group (PNP-ACG) has pushed for amendments to the SIM Card Registration Act, saying that despite its passage, almost all recent cybercrime cases in the country still involve subscriber identity modules (SIM) cards.

PNP-ACG director Maj. Gen.

Wilson Casil Asueta made the suggestion during a press briefing on Tuesday.
